design: Append a pure registry to selection.rs: CapabilitySet (provided_jvp, finite_difference, automatic_differentiation, explicit_jacobian, dense_matrix, newton) used both as permissions and as per-phase requirements

MethodDescriptor with method id/version/tableau identity, history steps, startup description, requirement variants (per_step, startup, optional fallback; per-variant mass/events/dense-output support), qualification (Production, ScopedCalibration, ImplementedUnqualified, ReferenceImplementationOnly), access (GeneralOdeSelectable vs ExplicitApiOnly), route string naming a real export

MethodRegistry::query(&MethodRequest) is pure: admitted iff some variant has per_step, startup and fallback subsets of the allowed set and supports the requested features, and the qualification is Production or ScopedCalibration unless admit_unqualified; refusals list typed reasons

CapabilitySet::from_problem_and_policy maps the existing Problem Jacobian variant and GeneralOdePolicy (DerivativeFallback, max_dense_dimension) without callbacks; Newton is never implied (fail closed)
MethodRequest/CapabilitySet are serde with deny_unknown_fields and no defaults: unknown and missing fields are refused

descriptors_verified_against_code.rodas5p: vigilode::Rodas5p::solve (dense, banded, FD, JVP routes per capabilities.rs)
descriptors_verified_against_code.ppsw1-6b dense: rodas5p_integrators::ppsw1::Session (dense J or n JVP columns, dense LU; starter dense 5n LU + simplified Newton)
descriptors_verified_against_code.radau-iia3: rodas5p_integrators::integrate_radau_adaptive_observed (dense_jacobian, LU, Newton; reference-implementation-only per CLI comparator fidelity)

acceptance: exhaustive 2^6 permissions x 2^3 features x admit flag against an independent table
zero callbacks during request construction and query
serde round trip, unknown and missing field refusal
every route string resolves to a compiled export in the test
non_goals: no activation of unqualified methods in GeneralOde
